english.title: Fail to provide service charge information to freehold house purchaser
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person entitled to enforce payment of a service charge in respect of a house at **(..SPECIFY HOUSE ADDRESS..), and having been requested in writing by **(..SPECIFY PERSON LIABLE TO PAY..), the person liable to pay the said service charge, to supply

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

with a written summary of the costs incurred in the twelve months ended **(..SPECIFY DATE..), which were relevant to the service charges payable or demanded as payable in the said period, failed without reasonable excuse to perform a duty imposed by section 48 of the Housing Act 1985 to comply with the request within the period referred to in section 48(2) of the Act and in the manner referred to in section 48(3) and (3A) in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 48(2), (3) and (3A) and 50 of the Housing Act 1985.
